propositions: The inbound fetcher currently processes only one tracker project per store mapping despite the mapping listing multiple projects, causing parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data to be silently dropped for all but one project.
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset.

The fetcher must fan out JQL queries and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps) once per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot while maintaining per-project truncation ceilings.
The source project can be derived from the jira key prefix and repos can be looked up from the project's mapping entry using a new helper in projects_store.py.
Single-project behavior (unseeded mapping) must remain byte-for-byte unchanged by falling back to the original single-project code path.
